bumped into a big Dan Skelton-trained gamble when placed on last month's handicap debut at Bangor and is taken to build on that performance. Hidden Target moves up in trip after keeping on well for third over 2m3f at Chepstow last month and is earmarked as a likely danger. Dessie Haze may have been slightly flattered by the way the race panned out when winning at Chepstow but he's still respected, while Stiletto probably needed his recent reappearance run and is reunited with Sean Bowen today.[Chris Wilson] Page 2 spotlightffos las 21.04.26

This is quite competitive for the grade, with several runners unexposed over 3m. GOLDEN

- Dan Boulton Novices' Handicap Hurdle £6,150 Total Race Value SKY 3m For 4yo+ Rated 0-105 Minimum weight 10-2 Penalties after April 11th, each hurdle won 7lb Penalty value 1st £3,247.81 2nd £1,494.44 3rd £747.23 4th £373.92 5th £186.35 SOFT Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Air Apparent 6 12-0 J S Mullins Paul O'Brien 10-1 105 80 102 Kept on for third in Hereford maiden (2m3f, good) last month, his fourth start over hurdles, and has plenty of scope for further improvement in staying handicaps; no surprise if he features. Washington Parks 7 11-13t1 K Bailey & M Nicholls Tom Bellamy 10-1 104 98 104 0-6 over hurdles when based in Ireland and absent since two down-the-field handicap runs last April (2m3f/2m4f), but still worth a glance in the betting before this stable debut; tongue-tie added. Hidden Target 7 11-11 R Phillips Gavin Sheehan 5-1 102 78 106 Bettered low-key handicap debut when keeping-on third at Chepstow (2m3f, good to soft) last month; 1lb lower here and pedigree suggests this longer trip will suit; high on the list. Smile Back 6 11-9 R Phillips Harry Bannister 14-1 100 102 104 Placed in three of her four handicaps but was beaten about 19l when weakening third at Carlisle (3m1f, soft) in February and is not making any progress; hood left off here; stablemate Hidden Target appeals more. Golden Prince 5 11-9 C Williams Jack Tudor 5-1 100 98 101 Unexposed 5yo who was evidently suited by the hike up in trip when third on handicap debut at Bangor (2m7f, good) three weeks ago; probably still has potential; might be the answer. Kastellion 6 11-8 Mel Rowley Charlie Hammond 7-1 99 99 104 Kept on for third on handicap debut at Southwell (2m4f, soft) in February but was disappointing favourite when weakening fourth at Bangor (2m7f, good) last month and needs a better effort here. Moon Over Clyro 6 11-8p1 R Llewellyn Charlie Price 33-1 99 53 106 Placed in two 2m Worcester maidens towards end of last summer but struggled in his first two handicaps (2m3f/2m2f); hiked up in trip with cheekpieces added today; leap of faith required to support him. Fanny Moon 6 11-7 Mel Rowley Charlie Deutsch 25-1 98 67 105 Unexposed after only four hurdle runs but was soundly beaten on last month's handicap debut at Bangor (2m3f, good); goes beyond about 2m5f for first time here. Stiletto 8 11-7p Mrs S Leech Sean Bowen 12-1 98 96 106 Did well for new stable in early part of season, winning three times under Sean Bowen (2m2f-3m, good/good to soft); returned from break with low-key run last month but has the champion jockey back on board today. Getaway King 8 11-4tp1 F O'Brien Tom Broughton (5) 8-1 95 - - Ex-Irish 8yo who started off for Fergal O'Brien with three chase wins (2m4f-2m5f) in the autumn; returned with a lesser effort in February and fell when last in action but remains unexposed over 3m; sports first-time cheekpieces for hurdling debut; could have a say. Dessie Haze 8 11-3 P Dando Ellis Collier (5) 4-1 94 86 110 Beat well-handicapped, odds-on favourite when staying on well to open account at Chepstow (2m7f, good to soft) 19 days ago, his eighth start over hurdles; 6lb higher here but may yet have more to offer. Glenmuick 5 10-5p1 C Longsdon Lilly Pinchin 33-1 82 89 109 Soundly beaten in first three handicap hurdles (2m-2m4f); needs combination of new trip and first-time cheekpieces to enable huge improvement. Eaststone Buck'S 5 10-2 Miss V Williams Ned Fox (3) 8-1 79 73 106 Well beaten in his three qualifying races (1m7f-2m4f) but fared better when keeping-on second (no match for winner) on handicap debut at Stratford (2m6f, soft) six weeks ago; 2lb wrong here but remains unexposed.

Cases can be made for a few of these but top of the list is low-mileage 6yo GAELIC RAMBLER (nap), who chased home a revitalised subsequent winner at Wetherby last month and might be seen to better effect over today's longer trip. Latenightrumble is second choice but Brulure Noire, Jeu d'Opale and Jaccours also warrant consideration.[Chris Wilson] Page 3 spotlightffos las 21.04.26

Thankyouandplease won't be far away if able to replicate the form he showed over a longer trip at Ayr on Friday but TRUST HOUSE was a convincing winner at Market Rasen last month and might still be on the upgrade. Handicap debutant Corner Forward will be feared if strong in the betting.[Chris Wilson] Page 4 spotlightffos las 21.04.26

- Alfie Boulton Handicap Hurdle £7,700 Total Race Value SKY 2m For 4yo+ Rated 0-110 (also open to such horses rated 111 and 112 - see Standard Conditions) Weights raised 1lb Minimum weight 10-2 Penalties after April 11th, each hurdle won 7lb Penalty value 1st £4,066.37 2nd £1,871.10 3rd £935.55 4th £468.16 5th £233.31 SOFT Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Chillhi 6 12-0 B J Murphy Dylan O'Connor (7) 20-1 109 104 111 Flat and dual hurdle winner during busy summer for James Owen last year but absent since two below-par runs for Alison Thorpe in October; considered only if lively in the market before this stable debut. Trust House 6 12-0 O Murphy Sean Bowen 11-8 109 89 112 Rewarded strong market support when winning readily at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft) last month, on his second run after a layoff, and is now 2-8 over hurdles; 8lb higher here but still commands respect. Thankyouandplease 6 11-13 S Hosie Mr Jack Stenhouse (7) 9-2 108 91 114 Dual 1m7f winner this season (heavy/good to soft); gave good account when second off today's career-high mark at Ayr (2m4f, soft) on Friday and has a fighting chance here, providing this race doesn't come too soon. Caelan 5 11-13t O Murphy Tom Hutsby (10) 7-1 108 93 112 Improved to win good-ground Worcester maiden (2m, good to soft) in September and subsequently made the frame in two 2m Huntington handicaps (good/good to soft); returns from four-month break on workable mark but riding arrangements suggest Trust House is the stable's main hope. Aeroplane Blonde 6 11-7p1 S Drinkwater Benjamin Macey (5) 14-1 102 89 112 Has a tendency to race too freely and is usually held up at the back; struggled to get competitive at Chepstow in February and now 0-6 over hurdles but interesting if judged on some of his form towards the end of last year; not out of this if first-time cheekpieces have positive effect. Eastern Shores 6 11-4ht F O'Brien Jonathan Burke 10-1 99 88 106 No match for winner when second on handicap debut at Huntingdon (2m, soft) in February and disappointed when upped to 2m3f at Bangor last month; not yet fully exposed but needs to find something extra here. Corner Forward 5 11-1 A Honeyball Richie McLernon 6-1 96 81 107 Showed only minor promise in his qualifying races (1m7f-2m1f) but may not have handled heavy ground last time; no surprise if he gets much more competitive on this handicap debut. Asta La Vista 5 10-11 C Longsdon Daire McConville (7) 10-1 92 104 106 Unexposed 5yo who was well beaten in his first two hurdle races but kept on to take a modest third at Wetherby (2m, good) last month and has plenty of scope for further improvement in handicaps.

He's no longer the force of old but ESPERTI looked in really good nick when winning over a marathon trip at Fakenham last week and, with this C&D also suitable, he might be able to overcome a 7lb penalty. Barring one fall, Mythe Bridge has a solid record over fences this season and is feared most. Bataillon beat two next-time-out winners when scoring at Taunton in January and is next on the list, while Ahanaglogh could still have potential.[Chris Wilson] Page 5 spotlightffos las 21.04.26

Ben Clarke's LARGY PANIC took a step forward when gamely getting off the mark at Kempton last time and can defy a 2lb rise with this return to a longer trip looking a positive. Olly Murphy's lightly raced Lemon Leaf could emerge as the main danger ahead of fellow handicap debutants Could Be You and Yourcardismarked.[Peter Entwistle] Page 6 spotlightffos las 21.04.26

- Dan Ward Handicap Hurdle (Div I) £6,150 Total Race Value SKY 2m4f For 4yo+ Rated 0-100 Weights raised 1lb Minimum weight 10-2 Penalties after April 11th, each hurdle won 7lb Penalty value 1st £3,247.81 2nd £1,494.44 3rd £747.23 4th £373.92 5th £186.35 SOFT Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Midnight Ginger 10 12-0 A Martin Dillon Butler (10) 12-1 99 61 98 On a long losing run but she wasn't discredited on the back of wind surgery when fourth of six in 2m3f Warwick handicap 60 days ago; possibilities off a falling mark. Largy Panic 6 11-10t B Clarke Tom Bellamy 2-1 95 97 99 Lightly raced 6yo who advanced his form on just his second go in handicap company when scoring at Kempton (2m) 29 days ago; up 2lb but showed a good attitude there and has a big shout with this return to further also a likely plus. Lemon Leaf 6 11-9 O Murphy Sean Bowen 7-2 94 64 100 Shaped well on his hurdling debut when second in 2m Aintree novice last May; well held after an absence both runs since at Wincanton and Warwick, but could still do better for leading yard now going into handicaps. Yourcardismarked 5 11-7t1 T Vaughan Jack Hogan 14-1 92 83 97 Did not offer much in three maiden hurdles (around 2m) this year but this son of Harzand goes handicapping now and is bred to be better suited by this longer trip; tongue-tie is also added. Kellebelle 5 11-2t D Jeffreys Beau Morgan (5) 6-1 87 94 102 Arrives in good nick since sent handicapping, third of six at Huntingdon (2m4f) in February; not out of things in her bid for a maiden victory. King Berry 5 10-12t1 M Comley David Bass 11-1 83 68 98 Modest form in bumpers (for Ed De Giles) and well held in three 2m maiden hurdles this year, beating one at Newbury last month; tongue tied for his handicap debut with much better required. Could Be You 6 10-12t1 N Mulholland Jack Tudor 6-1 83 46 98 Yet to show any form under rules, pulled up in 2m4f Leicester novice in January on his final run for Ryan Potter; tongue tied on yard/handicap debut and he could still take a step forward given he was placed in Irish points. Ferando 6 10-6t B J Murphy Tom Cannon 25-1 77 - 99 Looks a low-level maiden and beat only one in 2m3f handicap chase here nine days ago; tongue-strap is refitted here. Mind Hunter 8 10-3tb B Llewellyn Harry Atkins (7) 12-1 74 89 100 It's now 12 starts since his last success (2022) and he came in a below-par fifth of seven in 2m4f handicap at Leicester in November; others are preferred. Lancier Des Obeaux 5 10-2t1 Laura Horsfall Kevin Brogan 25-1 73 33 86 Has cut little ice in three maiden hurdles (at up to 2m3f) this year; tongue tied for this handicap debut.

to finally get off the mark, with the form of his second here last time out having proved strong for the grade. Unexposed handicap debutant Spanish Dancer could emerge as the chief threat ahead of Neeps And Tatties and Lion Of The Desert.[Peter Entwistle] Page 7

- Dan Ward Handicap Hurdle (Div II) £6,150 Total Race Value SKY 2m4f For 4yo+ Rated 0-100 Weights raised 2lb Minimum weight 10-2 Penalties after April 11th, each hurdle won 7lb Penalty value 1st £3,247.81 2nd £1,494.44 3rd £747.23 4th £373.92 5th £186.35 SOFT Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Spanish Dancer 7 12-0 R Bandey Harry Bannister 9-2 98 91 98 Has been brought along steadily, fifth of ten in 2m Lingfield novice hurdle in February; steps up in trip now going into handicaps and looks capable of better. Lion Of The Desert 6 11-10h G Harris Joe Anderson (3) 12-1 94 91 98 Still a maiden but he failed to stay when ninth in 3m Chepstow handicap 26 days ago; not out of things back in trip. Royal Rhythm 10 11-9p J & A J O'Neill Jonjo O'Neill Jr 7-1 93 80 97 Winless since 2023 and he's been off the track since pulled up in 3m handicap here in November; handily weighted if resurgent after a break. Cumhacht 8 11-5 Miss R Curtis Sean Bowen 11-4 89 78 102 Yet to score but he comes here on the back of a good second of six in 2m handicap here in February; the winner and third there have both gone in since, so he's a player off an unchanged mark. Neeps And Tatties 7 11-1h R Phillips Tom Bellamy 4-1 85 70 97 Low-mileage 7yo who took a step forward when second of six in C&D handicap last month; she can go well again nudged up 1lb. Forest Spirit 5 10-13 M Bowen James Bowen 12-1 83 52 86 A fair 1m4f Flat winner but she's yet to match that form in this sphere, fifth of six in C&D handicap in October; needs to step forward after her absence. Whatmakes Honey B 7 10-12t Miss H Brown Ben Godfrey 25-1 82 66 98 Ended last season with a breakthrough win at Taunton (2m3f) but she's offered little this season, a well-held sixth back at Taunton (3m) last month; not easy to make a case for. Jour D'Orage 7 10-6p N Mulholland Bradley Harris (3) 8-1 76 60 100 Still to get his head in front and he came in a never-dangerous seventh in 2m4f Wincanton handicap last month; others appeal more. Mancero 4 10-2b D Pipe Jack Tudor 15-2 82 69 102 French hurdles winner; yet to score for his current yard but he wasn't disgraced when fourth of 11 in 2m4f Wincanton handicap 20 days ago given he was set a lot to do; no forlorn hope from a falling mark.
